new_cases.what: Delete a tier that a later tier follows: the question lists the follower, then "This can't be undone." (no parts line)
In view, the Categories line cannot be changed; Edit turns it into the picker
Cancel after picking a category puts the line back and the category's parts keep their old matrix price
Switching a 3-range column to % Off counts 1 change; typing a value in each box makes 4
After that save, the Audit Log entry records the rule-type change and the 3 range values
Different values per range: the saved message reads "tier A is" and one bullet per range
More than one rule type in a tier: "tier A is multiple rules" and one bullet per type
Uncategorized's QuickBooks Products and Services can be changed and saved (QuickBooks connected: staging)
Work orders and Both each list only the customers on the tier for exactly that
